description: Course code equivalences for spring/summer eligibility. When a curriculum used an older code but the current transition JSON lists a renamed code (or the reverse), list them together here so completing either counts for prereq checks.
howToAdd: Add an object under equivalences with: codes (2+ interchangeable course codes), admitYears (inclusive from/to; omit a bound for open-ended), optional programs (list of program dropdown values, or omit/null for all programs), and a short note.

equivalences.note: Electrical/Computer (and related) layouts used CPS 125 through 2020; CPS 188 from 2021. Transition 2026 prereqs often list CPS 188 only.
